prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity flat Japanese browser application mockup, landscape 1920x1080 style. Product: ツリー通信v2 embedded in existing Tree Kids School reservation V2. This is a practical shipped staff workspace, not a marketing website. Background very pale gray, white surfaces, deep muted teal text, green teal actions, restrained blue/amber status chips, thin borders, compact readable Japanese sans serif. Use almost entire viewport with 24px side margins; no giant gutters, no oversized hero, no illustrations. Official logo is reference image 1: use the entire provided exact logo asset at native aspect ratio, never redraw or invent a replacement tree icon. Existing screenshot references 2 and 3 are context, not exact targets. Synthetic example child names only (児童A, 児童B etc), sample activity texts; no real family names from screenshots. Top small reservation shell with exact provided logo plus navigation 利用予定 / 空き状況 / 児童管理 / ツリー通信v2 / 設定. Second slim launcher bar: ‹ 予約V2へ戻る, ツリー通信v2, 共有保存, 集中表示. The design is clearly a function within the reservation application. Readable crisp Japanese text. Main screen: PC daily overview. Slim inner navigation 今日の記録 / 通信を整える / 履歴 / 業務・設定 with inline small count chips 今日の児童 8 / 入力完了 6 / 送信未確認 3, not giant KPI cards. One row date selector 2026年10月5日(月) previous/next/today and facility Tree Kids School Home. Four equally compact context cards side by side: 勤務スタッフ (names and time summary; 勤務管理 button), 特記事項 (two lines; 日報を開く button), 本日のプログラム (paper art title, staff; 内容を確認 button), 共有事項 (two lines; 日報を開く button). These are saved summaries, no fake autosaving edit fields. Main nearly full-width white table with heading 今日の記録. Toolbar search/filter left, 保護者へ公開 / LINE送信を確認 / 予約名簿を取り込む / + 児童を追加 right. Table columns 児童・状態 | 学習・プログラム | メモ・通信 | 今後の予定 | 送迎・担当 | 操作. 8 compact rows around 64px to 80px tall, show 6-7 rows in viewport. Identity column child names and separate input/publication badges. Communication column has 2-line snippets, not paragraphs. Transport column time and assigned staff. Actions small inline メモ / 通信, separate checkbox 送信済み. One sent row pale green with checkmark and text 送信済み, one public badge 保護者公開済み, one amber 変更あり. Sticky table header implied. Desktop practical density while all text readable. No left sidebar consuming width.
